notes: REGRESSION REPLAY fixtures in the shape the replay builder produces from real runs: the expected behavior is the recorded tool sequence, never an invented answer. These six are AUTHORED fixtures (clearly-labelled synthetic services, no production data and no jdds.db content) so the replay path has a frozen, reviewable input; real runs are turned into the same shape by `python -m harness.evaluation.replay_builder`. They are live-only, so the scripted tier reports them UNMEASURED rather than pretending a stale model response replays.
